'''''The Essential Guide to Warfare''''' is a third-generation [[Star Wars: Essential Guides|Essential Guide]] written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]. It was first published by [[Del Rey]] in paperback format on [[April 3]], [[2012]].

==Publisher's summary==
'''''THE DEFINITIVE GUIDE TO THE ULTIMATE INTERGALACTIC BATTLEFIELD'''''

''Like many a great epic, ''Star Wars'' is rooted in a rich history of armed conflict. Now, for the first time, the facts, figures, and fascinating backstories of major clashes and combatants in the vast ''Star Wars'' universe have been documented in one fully illustrated volume. Extensively researched and inventively written, ''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' combines action-filled narrative with encyclopedic knowledge that''
*''EXPLORES NOTABLE MILITARY UNITS AND GROUPS''
*''TRACES THE DEVELOPMENT OF SIGNIFICANT ARMAMENTS AND TECHNOLOGIES''
*''PROFILES KEY WARSHIP CLASSES, GROUND UNITS, AND MANUFACTURERS''
*''PROVIDES CAPSULE BIOGRAPHIES OF GREAT MILITARY LEADERS''
*''PRESENTS EYEWITNESS TROOPERS' ACCOUNTS OF COMBAT''
*''PLUS-ENOUGH ADDITIONAL PROFILES, INTEL, HISTORY, AND LORE TO SPAN THE COSMOS!''

''Encompassing all the ''Star Wars'' media, including the legendary films, the hit TV series ''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'', the bestselling books, comics, and videogames, and packed with original full-color artwork, ''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' is a conquering achievement''.

==Development==
The book was first announced as '''''The Essential Guide to the Star Wars Military''''' by [[Karen Traviss]] on her [http://www.karentraviss.com website] on [[August 5]], [[2008]]. Traviss later decided to end her ''Star Wars'' writing days with ''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''. Sue Rostoni confirmed in August [[2009]] that ''The Essential Guide to the Star Wars Military'' was to be written by a different author.<ref>{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=222689&start=9564#17707619|thread=Books, Comics, & Television VIPs|user=[[Sue Rostoni]]|date=2009-08-18|time=2:45 PM}}</ref> In May [[2010]], Rostoni released a publishing calendar that showed the newly retitled ''Essential Guide to Warfare'' with a June [[2011]] release date.<ref name="Calendar" /> In January [[2011]], Rostoni announced that the release date had been pushed back to [[March 20]], [[2012]]; however, in [[August]] 2011, the date was again pushed back to [[May 22]], 2012.<ref name="SWBooks">{{Facebook|username=StarWarsBooks|url=media/set/?set=a.10150411766083713.378495.67519418712&type=3|name=Star Wars Books|date=2011-11-14|quote=This album consists of approved concept sketches/paintings and final paintings by the talented artists working on the book STAR WARS: THE ESSENTIAL GUIDE TO WARFARE. I plan to continue to update this album as we grow closer to the on sale date in May of 2012. (ES)|archivedate=20201115130943}}</ref> In [[December]] 2011, what would be the actual release date of [[April 3]], 2012 was announced.<ref name="Penguin-Paperback" />

At [[Celebration V]], the book was also announced to contain a duty roster of [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] at the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a similar roster for [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] at the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], profiles of key conflicts and military leaders, more information on the [[Rishi Maze/Legends|Rishi Maze]] and the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] hyperspace barrier, and first-person "Soldier's Stories" accounts by frontline troops.

[[Del Rey]]'s preview gallery on Facebook included images of [[Dark Trooper/Legends|Dark troopers]], a [[World Devastator]], a battle between [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] and [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]], a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] fleet battling an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] fleet, a [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]–era [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] weapons [[Factory/Legends|factory]], [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] spaceships, [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] warship sketches, a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Owool Interceptor]] sketch, an Imperial recruiting poster featuring [[Shea Hublin]], a battle featuring [[Taung/Legends|Taungs]], several pictures of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], one set during the [[Battle of Kashyyyk (Second Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Kashyyyk]] in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], the title-page spread showing the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and an Imperial [[Altor-class replenishment ship|''Altor''-class replenishment ship]] refueling a [[Dreadnaught/Legends|dreadnaught]] and [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battlecruiser]].

In addition to the aforementioned ships, [[Lucas Licensing]] also utilized some [[fanon]] artwork created by [[Ansel Hsiao]] when writing the guide. When approached by Lucas Licensing to provide artwork for ''The Essential Guide to Warfare,'' Hsiao submitted his own designs in addition to new models, along with their names. These designs included the [[Assertor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Assertor''-class Star Dreadnought]] (as well as the specific ship within that class, [[Wrath (Assertor-class)/Legends|''Wrath'']]), the [[Bellator-class dreadnought/Legends|''Bellator''-class dreadnought]], the [[Allegiance-class battlecruiser|''Allegiance''-class battlecruiser]], the [[Secutor-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Secutor''-class Star Destroyer]], the [[Procursator-class Star Destroyer|''Procursator''-class Star Destroyer]], the [[Altor-class replenishment ship|''Altor''-class replenishment ship]], the [[Vigil-class corvette|''Vigil''-class corvette]], and the [[Naval Station Validusia/Legends|Naval Station ''Validusia'']]. In addition to the ships and images made by Hsiao, at least one Tommy Lee Edwards artwork also incorporated artwork by Hsiao; specifically, the image of Captain Firmus Piett and Admiral Kendal Ozzel observing a gathering fleet incorporated into the background Hsiao's artwork "Strategic Reserves." The names were recorded in [[Lucasfilm]]'s [[Holocron continuity database]], according to the artist.<ref name="Fractalsponge comments">{{WebCite|url=https://bbs.stardestroyer.net/viewtopic.php?f=46&t=124353&sid=e8501d9d9e2ccc9a1c18226a2628097f&start=1575|text=Something big - Page 64|work=stardestroyer.net|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/Xcz6}}</ref>

Beginning in [[September]] [[2013]], Fry and Del Rey editor [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] released a [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|twelve-part series]] on the [[Star Wars Blog|''Star Wars'' Blog]] introducing sections that had been cut from the final publication.
